patient.name: Arthur Pendelton
patient.history: Severe tricompartmental osteoarthritis right knee, pre-diabetes

timeline.narration: Right lower extremity prepped and draped. Thigh tourniquet inflated to 275 mmHg.
Anterior midline skin incision. Medial parapatellar arthrotomy performed. Patella everted.
timeline.visible_findings: Severe tricompartmental cartilage loss, osteophytes on medial femoral condyle

timeline.narration: Distal femoral and proximal tibial bone cuts completed using alignment guide. Trial components placed.
timeline.visible_findings: Trial femoral component size 5 and tibial component size 4 seated; flex/ext gap balanced

timeline.narration: Polybone cement applied. Final Cobalt-Chrome femoral & Polyethylene tibial components impacted. Tourniquet deflated.
timeline.visible_findings: Final components rigidly seated; excess cement removed; minor bone bed bleeding controlled
timeline.danger_zone: Popliteal vascular bundle behind posterior capsule
